en: “Uh... can you see me?”
“Hehe, nope.”
“But I just... I just sat down.”
“Ah, it must be the sound of the door and your footsteps?”
“I can recognize almost everyone here by their steps!”
“That's impressive. Not surprised, you're amazing.”
“And I can tell who it is as soon as they speak—”
“Ha... Yeah, well... I'm kinda embarrassed, to be honest.”
“Haha, don't worry about it, let's just chat.”
“Can I really talk about anything here, even unpleasant stuff?”
“Of course, anything at all. After all, I'm a nun.”
“Whatever happens here is forgotten once you step outside.”
“Though I might not be able to help, what's wrong with a little chat with Sister K?”
“Sister K?”
“That's what I tell the kids here, do you mind?”
“Not at all... Sister K, um, got it!”
“Haha that's the spirit. Good boy—”
“Why are you coming to spend time with me now?”
“You know I've been waiting...”
“Kasumi...”
“Are you being mean on purpose?”
“I... like seeing you in your nun outfit.”
“You know we can't do that here.”
Kasumi pulls open the curtain.
You're supposed to only be able to see one side of this. But now all I see is... a mouth.
“Wanna give it a try?”
“Kinda hot...”
“Again?”
“Wanna see another part of a nun?”
The curtain gets pulled open again.
But now what I see isn't the mouth... it's a wet vagina.
It looks like she's been rubbing it for quite some time. It's so wet that it's dripping.
“Kasumi, you're so naughty.”
“Hey, you did this.”
“I know we shouldn't do this here... But I'm so excited.”
